Built for this platform

What you can do with Microsoft Ads MCP

01

Turn reports into a conversation

Request campaign performance without manually handling report downloads. Adport manages Microsoft’s asynchronous report flow and returns normalized results.

02

Compare search accounts

Inspect campaign spend and available conversion metrics alongside another connected search provider. Keep currencies and attribution settings separate when interpreting differences.

03

Review status and daily budgets

Preview campaign activation, pausing, or budget adjustments. Protected-account and budget-cap policies apply before an operation can be executed.

Know what the data means

Microsoft Advertising reports can take time to generate. OAuth connectivity does not prove billing eligibility, advertiser verification, or permissions for every requested operation.

Local setup · Bring your own credentials

Connect Microsoft Ads to Claude Code or Cursor.

The npm CLI and MCP server run on your machine. You need Node.js 22.13 or newer, your own provider credentials, and permission to access the ad account.

01 Install Adport

npm install -g adport

02 Connect Microsoft Ads

adport connect microsoft

The wizard selects sandbox or production and opens a PKCE sign-in flow. Rotated refresh tokens are persisted in the local credential store.

03 Check your connection

adport doctor
adport accounts --provider microsoft

Check that the intended account appears before asking your agent to report on it. Never paste tokens, client secrets, or private keys into chat.

Before you connect

  • A Microsoft Advertising developer token for the intended environment.
  • An Entra app configured as a public/native client with the local redirect URI http://localhost. The local flow does not need a client secret.
  • A Microsoft identity with accepted access to the advertiser or manager account. Tenant policies may require administrator consent.
Full Microsoft Ads connection guideOfficial Microsoft Ads API documentation

Adport is independent and is not endorsed by Microsoft Ads. Provider access and approval are separate from installing this package.

Your tools. Your choice.

Use Microsoft Ads from your agent.

Microsoft Ads in Claude Code

After connecting locally, register Adport as a stdio MCP server:

claude mcp add --transport stdio adport -- adport mcp

Start a new session and ask Claude to list your connected Microsoft Ads accounts.

Claude Code MCP documentation

Microsoft Ads in Cursor

Add this entry to your Cursor MCP configuration. Merge it with existing servers rather than replacing them:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "adport": {
      "command": "adport",
      "args": [
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

The command must be available on Cursor’s PATH. Enable the server and ask the agent to inspect your account.

Cursor MCP documentation

You stay in control

A suggestion is not a live change.

The first mutation call returns a preview and a short-lived pending-operation token. Applying requires that token and the same arguments. Budget caps and protected accounts are checked by the policy engine; new campaigns are paused by policy.

Local operations are recorded in an append-only audit log. An approved preview is not a guarantee of provider acceptance, and a connected agent does not grant additional account permissions.

Microsoft Ads MCP questions

Is Bing Ads supported by this Microsoft MCP?

Yes. Bing Ads is the former name many advertisers still use for Microsoft Advertising. Connect with the microsoft provider command, not a separate bing provider.

Can I use Microsoft Ads locally without Adport Cloud?

Yes. Install Adport from npm, connect your own Microsoft Ads credentials, and register the local MCP server with a stdio-compatible agent such as Claude Code or Cursor. Your provider may have its own approval, access, or billing requirements.

Why can I connect an account but not read a report or apply a change?

Account discovery, reporting, and mutations can require different permissions. Check the requested account, provider app scopes, advertiser eligibility, and environment. Start with adport doctor and the connection guide above. Do not bypass a denied operation by sharing secrets with the agent.
